verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents customizable automation and configurable workflows, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automation definitions. The general audit trail and the case-level approval reviews are adjacent features about case work, not version control for automations, and workflows appear to be configured by the vendor ('We can easily configure your Hummingbird account').

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
